en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a town square with people standing in the foreground and two oxen pulling a cart. A tall clocktower rises in the background above low buildings. Signs on the buildings read in Italian, including a café and a bazaar. The word "Cavalese" is printed in red at the upper left, and there is a large inscription "GRAN BAZAR AL BUON MERCATO" on the right building.
